supplements.title: Molecular mechanism of anticancer activity of selected coastal marsh plants from Saudi Arabia.
supplements.summary: Coastal marsh plant extracts, especially A. marina, kill multiple cancer cell types by triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis through specific gene pathway changes.

supplements.title: Icaritin Sensitizes Hepatocellular Carcinoma to PD-L1 Therapy by NQO1-Dependent Ferroptosis Induction.
supplements.summary: Icaritin makes liver cancer cells more vulnerable to immune therapy by triggering a cell death process and boosting natural killer immune cells.

supplements.title: Equivalent Acute Anti-Inflammatory Effects of Exercise in Type 2 Diabetes Versus Healthy Adults: A Randomised Crossover Study.
supplements.summary: Exercise reduces inflammation equally in people with type 2 diabetes and healthy adults, suggesting similar protective benefits.

supplements.title: Network pharmacology-based therapeutic intervention of Mentha arvensis targeting cancer and doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity.
supplements.summary: Mentha arvensis plant extract may protect the heart from doxorubicin chemotherapy damage while preserving its anti-cancer effectiveness.

supplements.title: Integrative analysis reveals luteolin's molecular targets and mechanisms in pancreatic cancer treatment.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a natural plant compound, shows promise in treating pancreatic cancer by targeting specific molecular pathways.

supplements.title: The Effects of Apigenin on Immune Responses and Inflammatory Biomarkers in Sepsis: A Comprehensive Systematic Review.
supplements.summary: Apigenin, a citrus flavonoid, may help regulate immune responses and reduce inflammation in sepsis patients.

supplements.title: Bacteroides-associated NAD⁺ depletion correlates with exacerbated radiation-induced colorectal injury and impaired mucosal proliferative capacity.
supplements.summary: Certain gut bacteria deplete NAD⁺ levels, worsening radiation damage to the colon; NAD⁺ supplementation reverses this injury in colorectal tissue.

supplements.title: Comparison of hydrogen administration methods in the treatment of radiation-induced heart disease in rats.
supplements.summary: Molecular hydrogen, administered via water or inhalation, reduced radiation-induced heart damage in rats by decreasing oxidative stress and inflammation.

supplements.title: A Systematic Review of Turmeric/Curcumin for Prevention and Treatment of Oral Mucositis Due to Radiotherapy and/or Chemotherapy for Head and Neck Cancer.
supplements.summary: Turmeric may help reduce painful mouth damage from head and neck cancer treatment, offering a safer natural alternative to current therapies.

supplements.title: Alpha-lipoic acid as a preventive measure in radiation-induced oral mucositis in head and neck cancer patients: A randomized controlled study.
supplements.summary: Alpha-lipoic acid reduced radiation-induced mouth sores in head and neck cancer patients undergoing radiation therapy.

supplements.title: Autophagy as a therapeutic linchpin in metabolic diseases and obesity-associated diabetes.
supplements.summary: Restoring autophagy through exercise, diet, and drugs shows promise for treating obesity and type 2 diabetes by improving metabolic health.

supplements.title: Salvianolic acid B attenuates post-cardiac arrest cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury via activation of the Nrf2 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Salvianolic acid B reduces brain damage after cardiac arrest by activating protective cellular pathways that fight oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Gomisin B promotes RSL3-induced ferroptosis in neuroblastoma by inhibiting the ESR1/USP7/SREBF1 axis.
supplements.summary: Gomisin B kills neuroblastoma cells by blocking a protein pathway that normally prevents iron-related cell death.

supplements.title: Small RNA sequencing analysis identified miR159a as a novel candidate for activity in plant-derived nanovesicles from limon, hassaku, and sudachi.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified miR159a as the most abundant microRNA in citrus-derived nanovesicles, suggesting potential anti-cancer activity in colon cancer cells.

supplements.title: β-catenin mutation reprograms ketone body metabolism to drive hepatocellular carcinoma metastasis and resistance to ketogenic therapy via transcriptional activation of OXCT1.
supplements.summary: A β-catenin mutation in liver cancer activates an enzyme that converts ketone bodies to glutamate, causing resistance to ketogenic diet therapy and increased spread.

off_label.title: Low-dose nivolumab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy in borderline resectable oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II trial.
off_label.summary: Low-dose immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy improved surgical conversion rates in borderline resectable oral cancer.

off_label.title: Conserved use of tetraspanin CD9 as an entry receptor by rhabdoviruses spanning multiple genera.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified CD9 protein as a shared entry receptor for multiple rhabdoviruses across species and found nitazoxanide as a potential broad-spectrum antiviral treatment.

off_label.title: Semaglutide alleviates ovarian ferroptosis in polycystic ovary syndrome and is associated with reduced GPX4 promoter hypermethylation.
off_label.summary: Semaglutide improves polycystic ovary syndrome by reversing ovarian cell damage through reducing harmful DNA methylation patterns.

off_label.title: Inhibition of NAMPT targets DNA damage response to sensitize alkylating chemotherapy in TP53 mutant mantle cell lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking NAMPT in TP53-mutant mantle cell lymphoma makes cancer cells vulnerable to chemotherapy by disrupting DNA damage response.

off_label.title: Management of Treatment Resistant EGFR Inhibitor-Induced Papulopustular Exanthema With Isotretinoin and Dapsone.
off_label.summary: Isotretinoin and dapsone effectively treat severe skin rashes caused by cancer drugs when standard antibiotics fail.

off_label.title: MCT1 inhibition reprograms Treg metabolism via ABC transporters: implications for tumor immunity and the prognosis of acute myeloid leukemia patients.
off_label.summary: Blocking MCT1 in immune cells disrupts their metabolism and activates a pathway linked to better survival in acute myeloid leukemia patients.

off_label.title: Evaluating Therapeutic Efficacy of SCL7A11 and GLUT1 Inhibition in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer via a GSH/ATP Dual-NIR-Responsive Fluorogenic Sensor.
off_label.summary: Blocking two metabolic proteins simultaneously kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by creating energy imbalance and oxidative stress.

off_label.title: SHAPE-ENDO (Semaglutide + Hormonal Approach & Prehabilitation in Endometrial Cancer): Prospective Observational Study for Metabolic and Surgical Optimization in Patients With Atypical Endometrial Hyperplasia or Early-stage Endometrial Cancer and BMI ≥35.
off_label.summary: A multimodal approach combining semaglutide, hormonal therapy, and lifestyle changes helps obese women with early endometrial cancer lose weight and qualify for minimally invasive surgery.

off_label.title: M4OC-Prevent: Metformin for Oral Cancer Prevention
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise in preventing oral cancer development in patients with precancerous mouth lesions.

off_label.title: Evaluation of LG's anticancer acti̇vi̇ty on human gastric cancer cell line HGC-27 via molecular docking and gene expression analysis.
off_label.summary: Linagliptin, a diabetes drug, kills gastric cancer cells by disrupting Hedgehog signaling and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate microemulsion eyedrops for treating nitrogen mustard induced corneal injury.
off_label.summary: Fenofibrate eyedrops effectively treat nitrogen mustard-induced corneal injury by restoring protective protein levels and reducing inflammation in rat models.

off_label.title: Pomalidomide for hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia: after trial longitudinal assessment study (PATH-HHT ATLAS).
off_label.summary: Pomalidomide significantly reduced severe nosebleeds in hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia patients over four years, though side effects required dose adjustments.

off_label.title: Impact of statin use on cardiovascular and hematologic outcomes among patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms.
off_label.summary: Statins reduce heart attack and stroke risk in myeloproliferative neoplasm patients, particularly those with essential thrombocythemia or polycythemia vera.

off_label.title: Impact of proton pump inhibitors on immunotherapy is modulated by prior chemotherapy and linked to gut microbiome-immune cell signatures.
off_label.summary: Common heartburn drugs (PPIs) reduce immunotherapy effectiveness in advanced cancer, particularly melanoma, by altering gut bacteria.

off_label.title: Metabolic, microbial, and pharmacological stimuli elicit distinct lipidomic and cytokine responses in human placenta.
off_label.summary: Different stressors trigger distinct lipid and immune responses in placental tissue, with bacterial exposure causing inflammation linked to pregnancy complications.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the molecular mechanisms underlying the inflammation-cancer transformation in Hashimoto thyroiditis using single-cell transcriptomics.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how chronic thyroid inflammation transforms into cancer: immune cells called mast cells drive the transition through a specific signaling pathway.

biomarkers.title: Prednisolone modulates CD8⁺ and regulatory T-cell activity to dampen response to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in melanoma.
biomarkers.summary: Prednisolone steroid treatment dampens melanoma patients' immune response to checkpoint inhibitor therapy by suppressing cancer-fighting T-cells.

biomarkers.title: Fibroblast-activation protein inhibitors based positron emission tomography (PET) for assessing lung disease: A systematic review with meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: A new PET imaging technique using fibroblast-activation protein inhibitors shows promise for diagnosing lung cancer and interstitial lung disease.

biomarkers.title: Molecular mechanism of anticancer activity of selected coastal marsh plants from Saudi Arabia.
biomarkers.summary: Coastal marsh plant extracts, especially A. marina, kill multiple cancer cell types by triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis through specific gene pathway changes.

biomarkers.title: Conserved use of tetraspanin CD9 as an entry receptor by rhabdoviruses spanning multiple genera.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified CD9 protein as a shared entry receptor for multiple rhabdoviruses across species and found nitazoxanide as a potential broad-spectrum antiviral treatment.

biomarkers.title: BRCA1-A and LIG4 complexes mediate ecDNA biogenesis and cancer drug resistance.
biomarkers.summary: BRCA1-A and LIG4 proteins enable cancer cells to create circular DNA structures that help them resist chemotherapy and targeted drugs.

biomarkers.title: Viral mimicry may help explain immunogenic cell death.
biomarkers.summary: A gold compound kills colorectal cancer cells by mimicking viral infection, triggering strong immune responses against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Integrative analysis of mRNA stability regulation uncovers a metastasis-suppressive program in breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that the RBMS3 protein stabilizes cancer-suppressing genes in breast cancer, and its loss promotes metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Overcoming claudin family homology: discovery of ARC101, a highly potent CLDN6-specific T-cell engager with a novel CD3 binder for ovarian adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: ARC101, a new immunotherapy drug, targets ovarian cancer cells by precisely activating immune T cells against a cancer protein while avoiding healthy tissues.

biomarkers.title: Prognostic impact of myelodysplasia-related gene mutations in ELN-2022 favorable-risk acute myeloid leukemia subtypes.
biomarkers.summary: Certain gene mutations previously thought harmless may worsen outcomes in favorable-risk acute myeloid leukemia patients.

biomarkers.title: Mapping the TNFR2-targeting antibody patent landscape: Insights from macro trends to structural signatures.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified five distinct antibody designs targeting TNFR2 for cancer immunotherapy, revealing structural features that distinguish effective from ineffective approaches.

biomarkers.title: Assessment of the adequacy of the Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) Genomics standard for the representation of somatic testing reports.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers evaluated whether FHIR Genomics standard adequately communicates cancer genetic testing results and treatment implications in medical reports.

biomarkers.title: The membrane-associated ubiquitin ligase MARCHF8 degrades MHC-I in HPV-positive head and neck cancer for immune evasion.
biomarkers.summary: HPV-positive head and neck cancer uses a protein called MARCHF8 to hide from immune cells; blocking it restores immune detection and tumor control.

biomarkers.title: Psoriasis-like disease prevents squamous skin tumor development by neutrophil-driven inflammation.
biomarkers.summary: Psoriasis-like inflammation prevents squamous skin cancer through neutrophil-driven immune responses that trigger cell death and aging.

biomarkers.title: Elevated phthalate exposure and metabolic susceptibility increased breast cancer risk: A 20-y follow-up study in Taiwan.
biomarkers.summary: High exposure to DEHP phthalates increases breast cancer risk, especially combined with early menstruation onset, in this 20-year Taiwan study.

trials.title: Prednisolone modulates CD8⁺ and regulatory T-cell activity to dampen response to immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy in melanoma.
trials.summary: Prednisolone steroid treatment dampens melanoma patients' immune response to checkpoint inhibitor therapy by suppressing cancer-fighting T-cells.

trials.title: Low-dose nivolumab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy in borderline resectable oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma: a phase II trial.
trials.summary: Low-dose immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and oral metronomic therapy improved surgical conversion rates in borderline resectable oral cancer.

trials.title: Viral mimicry may help explain immunogenic cell death.
trials.summary: A gold compound kills colorectal cancer cells by mimicking viral infection, triggering strong immune responses against tumors.

trials.title: Overcoming claudin family homology: discovery of ARC101, a highly potent CLDN6-specific T-cell engager with a novel CD3 binder for ovarian adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: ARC101, a new immunotherapy drug, targets ovarian cancer cells by precisely activating immune T cells against a cancer protein while avoiding healthy tissues.

trials.title: FGTI-2734 prevents ERK-mediated resistance and enhances MRTX1133 efficacy in KRAS G12D pancreatic cancer.
trials.summary: A new drug combination overcomes resistance to KRAS pancreatic cancer treatment by blocking an escape pathway that cancer cells use.

trials.title: Potential induction of protective anti-tumor immune response in cancer patients by oncolytic viruses containing the GGTA1 gene.
trials.summary: Modified oncolytic viruses with the GGTA1 gene boost immune responses against tumors by converting infected cancer cells into therapeutic vaccines.

trials.title: Perioperative treatment in resectable gastric cancer with spartalizumab in combination with fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin and docetaxel (FLOT): Results from the GASPAR phase 2 study.
trials.summary: Adding the immune drug spartalizumab to standard gastric cancer chemotherapy (FLOT) improved treatment outcomes in resectable patients.

trials.title: Cancer-associated fibroblast signature and SMAD4 mutation in resistance to adjuvant chemotherapy in stage III colon cancer patients.
trials.summary: Researchers identified fibroblast patterns and SMAD4 mutations that predict which stage III colon cancer patients will resist chemotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Current treatment strategies for first relapse of high-risk neuroblastoma.
trials.summary: High-risk neuroblastoma patients who relapse should receive tumor biopsies for molecular testing, then chemotherapy combined with immunotherapy or targeted drugs based on genetic mutations.

trials.title: Larotrectinib in patients with tropomyosin receptor kinase fusion solid tumors in Spain (SPAINTRK).
trials.summary: Larotrectinib effectively treats solid tumors with specific genetic mutations in Spanish patients.

trials.title: Institutional variability in testing for actionable genetic alterations in patients with stage IIIB/C or IV non-small cell lung cancer: A real-world study from the German prospective, observational, multicenter CRISP registry (AIO-TRK-0315).
trials.summary: German hospitals vary significantly in genetic testing rates for advanced lung cancer, potentially affecting treatment options and patient outcomes.

trials.title: Treatment Patterns and Clinical Outcomes in Metastatic HR+/HER2- and Triple-Negative Breast Cancer in Canada: The HER2- TRENDS Study.
trials.summary: Canadian study reveals how doctors treat HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer and documents real-world patient outcomes.

trials.title: Development of a Nomogram to Predict Therapeutic Resistance in Metastatic Melanoma Using Longitudinal ctDNA Kinetics.
trials.summary: Researchers created a tool using blood tumor DNA patterns to predict treatment resistance in metastatic melanoma earlier than imaging scans.

trials.title: Recommendations for selection, treatment, and follow-up in peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (PRRT) for neuroendocrine tumors: a Delphi consensus from the Galician Multidisciplinary Group on Neuroendocrine and Endocrine Tumors (GGNET).
trials.summary: Experts provide guidelines for selecting neuroendocrine tumor patients for radioactive peptide therapy and monitoring their treatment outcomes.

trials.title: Comprehensive circulating tumor DNA mutation profiling via CAPP-Seq liquid biopsy for cervical cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a blood test using CAPP-Seq to detect cervical cancer DNA mutations early through liquid biopsy.
